title: Reduced boundary of a smooth curve is smooth of dimension zero
statement: Let $k$ be a perfect field, let $C$ be a smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] finite-type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme] of pure dimension one [def-weil-pure-dimension], and let $j:U\to C$ be a dense open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $i:Z\to C$ be the reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] closed complement [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then $Z$ is a finite-type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] zero-dimensional [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] $k$-scheme, and its structure morphism $Z\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of pure relative dimension zero [def-weil-pure-dimension].

source.place: Step 2: the reduced scheme Z is a finite disjoint union of spectra of perfect fields, hence smooth of dimension zero
